title: Apple's bond sale is now confirmed at $7.5 billion
summary: Details of Apple's expected bond sale have now been confirmed in SEC filings, which show the company aims to raise a slightly higher than expected $7.5 billion. Apple Park - image credit Apple. It had been reported that Apple was aiming to raise around $7 billion through this bond offering, which is the sale of debt. That report was based on a preliminary filing with the SEC, but now the final pricing term sheet has been published. title: Apple is gearing up for a fresh $7 billion in bond sale
summary: Apple is reportedly seeking about $7 billion through a new bond offering, potentially raising more money for stock buybacks, dividends, and other corporate expenses. Apple Stocks A preliminary prospectus filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on November 5 confirms plans to issue seven series of bonds. However, the filing doesn't specify the total offering amount or final interest rates. The offering would be Apple's first since May 2025, when it raised $4.5 billion through a four-part bond sale.
